subject.title: refactor: move provider transports into packages/ai behind a typed host port

question: Should `@openclaw/ai/transports` become a supported external plugin/package API, or should this refactor retain a private transport seam and expose only narrow approved facades?
rationale: The code can mechanically move either way, but only maintainers can decide the permanent plugin compatibility promise and ownership boundary for provider transport behavior.

options.title: Keep transports private
options.body: Retain the typed core host port but remove the broad public transport export, preserving existing supported SDK facades until a narrower need is approved.

options.title: Approve a narrow transport API
options.body: Define the exact supported exports, document their compatibility policy, and add focused contract coverage before retaining a public transport subpath.

recommendation.title: Keep transports private
recommendation.body: Retain the typed core host port but remove the broad public transport export, preserving existing supported SDK facades until a narrower need is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the current host-port and transport-boundary design and is best placed to provide the intended API scope for maintainer approval.
